title: Finora Offline Receipt
description: One offline payment receipt, signed by the payer's device key. Money is integer paise. Timestamps are Unix seconds (UTC). Contains no personal data.

allowanceId.description: Id of the allowance certificate this spend draws from. ASCII only.

counter.description: Per-allowance spend counter. Starts at 1 and goes up by exactly 1 per receipt. (allowanceId, counter) is the double-spend key on the ledger.

amountPaise.description: Amount in integer paise (100 paise = Rs 1). Never a float.

payeeId.description: Opaque merchant id issued by Finora. Not a phone number or UPI id.

nonce.description: 16 random bytes as 32 lowercase hex characters. Makes every receipt unique.

ts.description: Unix seconds (UTC) on the payer's device when the receipt was made.

prevHash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the previous receipt in this allowance (the digest that receipt's sig covers). For counter 1 use 64 zeros.

sig.description: Standard base64 (with padding) of the DER-encoded ECDSA P-256 signature over SHA-256(canonical JSON of all fields except sig).
